notes: The table is printed across two pages (physical pages 66-67): page 66 carries the caption, the two-row header and eight cell rows; page 67 repeats the header and prints one further cell row ('Municipal Departments').
Title as printed, complete: 'Table 2.2: Comparative Institutional Roles for Urban Water Services Delivery among Select States'. The catalog unit title for this table stops at '...among'.
Printed as 'Orissa (WATCO)'; not corrected (Odisha is the current name).
Row 2 prints 'State- level specialist agency' in the Capital works column with a space after the hyphen; transcribed as printed, not corrected.

Rows 1-3 print 'State-level specialist agency' once in the Type of agency column. Because the third cell row begins on the next state grouping in the source layout, the state-level block is recorded as a three-row span exactly as ruled in the table.

Cell text is printed fully justified, so single cells are broken across lines with wide inter-word gaps ('Kerala (KWA)    Jharkhand (WSSD    + JUIDCO)'). Line breaks are joined with single spaces; every word and mark is as printed.
Type of agency, Jurisdiction and State Examples headers each span the printed two-row header band; O&M and Capital works sit under the printed 'Responsibilities' heading.
Physical column rules are at x=77.4, 175.2, 261.4, 323.0, 385.0 and 528.4 points; horizontal rules differ by row and were used to confirm every merged cell recorded in cell_spans.

State Examples cells are printed either as comma-separated lists or as one name per line. Row 'Small/large cities' prints Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh one per line with no commas, and row 'Specialist municipal undertaking (SMU)' prints Delhi and Shimla the same way; those cells are joined here with single spaces only, no separators added.
Row 'Small/large cities' Jurisdiction cell is printed 'Small/large' over 'cities' with a solidus; kept as printed.

The Type of agency cell of the Specialist municipal undertaking row is printed 'Specialist municipal undertaking (SMU)' across four lines; the 'Metropolitan-level Specialist agency' cell breaks after 'Metropolitan-'; hyphens are line-break hyphens in the source and are kept.
Baseline catalog metadata splits this table across pages 66-67 with label range 14-15; both pages were read for this transcription.
Row indexing in cell_spans is 0-based over the nine cell rows; the header entry is marked header=true. Row 8 ('Municipal Departments') is the row printed on physical page 67.
